scenario.title: 在市集殺價、比價
scenario.context: 在東南亞市集殺價時，會一直比價錢：「這裡比那攤貴兩倍」「沒有那家一半便宜」。英文用 twice as… as、half as… as、three times more… 表達倍數比較，結構和中文差很多。

lines.speaker: Seller
lines.en: Beautiful scarves! Pure silk. Only 800 baht.
lines.zh: 漂亮的圍巾！純絲，只要 800 泰銖。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: 800? The stall next door has the same one for half as much.
lines.zh: 800？隔壁攤一樣的只要一半價錢。

lines.speaker: Seller
lines.en: Not the same quality! Mine is twice as soft. Feel it.
lines.zh: 品質不一樣！我的軟兩倍，你摸摸看。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: It's nice, but it's not twice as nice. How about 400?
lines.zh: 是不錯，但沒有好兩倍。400 怎麼樣？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: What if I buy three? Can you do 1,300 for all of them?
lines.zh: 如果我買三條呢？三條 1,300 可以嗎？

lines.speaker: Seller
lines.en: OK, OK, 1,400 and it's a deal.

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: How much did you pay for those?

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: 1,400 for three. I haggled her down from 2,400.
lines.zh: 三條 1,400。我從 2,400 殺下來的。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Nice! I'm too shy to haggle. I always pay three times as much as everyone else.
lines.zh: 厲害！我太害羞不敢殺價，我總是付別人三倍的錢。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: My mom taught me. She's a bit of a cheapskate, honestly.
lines.zh: 我媽教我的。說真的她有點小氣。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Well, tonight I'm going to splash out on a nice dinner. Want to come?
lines.zh: 嗯，今晚我要揮霍一下吃頓好的，要一起來嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Sure, as long as it doesn't break the bank.
lines.zh: 好啊，只要不會花到破產就好。

patterns.en: That's a bit out of my budget.
Can you do a better price?
I saw it cheaper at another stall.
patterns.zh: 我在另一攤看到比較便宜的。

patterns.note: 殺價時轉身要走的經典台詞

patterns.en: It costs twice as much here.

chinglish.wrong: This is two times expensive than that one.
chinglish.right: This is twice as expensive as that one.
chinglish.why: 倍數比較的結構是 twice / three times + as + 形容詞 + as。中文「貴兩倍」直翻結構會錯。

chinglish.right: Can you do a better price?
chinglish.why: 中式「可以便宜嗎」直翻不是英文句子（複習第 6 單元）。

chinglish.right: This one is half the price. / This one costs half as much.
chinglish.why: 「便宜一半」要說 half the price / half as much。

chinglish.wrong: I bought it with very cheap price.
chinglish.right: I got it for a really good price. / I got it cheap.
chinglish.why: 價格的介系詞是 for / at，而且 price 前要有冠詞。

grammar.title: 倍數比較 twice as… as
grammar.oneLiner: 倍數 + as + 形容詞 / 副詞 + as；也可以用 倍數 + 比較級 + than 或 倍數 + the + 名詞。
whenToUse: as… as（一樣）：This one is as good as that one.
not as… as（不如）：It's not as cheap as I thought.
倍數 + as… as：twice as expensive as / three times as big as / half as much as。
倍數 + the + 名詞：twice the price / half the size / three times the amount。
倍數 + 比較級 + than：three times more expensive than（口語常用，但正式寫作偏好 as… as）。
much / many：I paid twice as much. / There were three times as many people.
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文「貴兩倍」「大三倍」「便宜一半」把倍數放在形容詞後面，英文卻放在前面，還要用 as… as 包起來。而且中文「貴兩倍」到底是原價的兩倍還是多兩倍，本身就有歧義，英文的 twice as expensive 則明確是「兩倍的價格」。

examples.correct: The hotel was twice as expensive as the hostel.
examples.incorrect: The hotel was two times expensive than the hostel.
examples.note: 倍數 + as + 形容詞 + as。

examples.correct: This bag is half the price of the one at the mall.
The market is not as crowded as it was yesterday.
I paid three times as much as you did.
examples.note: 講金額用 as much as。

examples.correct: Their apartment is about twice the size of mine.

quiz.question: This scarf is half the ___ of that one. (價格)
The night market isn't ___ busy as it is on weekends.
There were three times as ___ tourists as last year.
quiz.explanation: 可數名詞用 as many as。

quiz.question: Which is correct?
options: My room is double big than yours.
My room is twice as big as yours.
My room is two times big as yours.

slang.usage: haggle over the price / haggle someone down（把某人的價錢殺下來）。

risk.note: 中性用語。在歐美多數商店殺價會很尷尬，市集和二手市場才適合。

examples.en: You're expected to haggle at this market.
examples.zh: 這個市場本來就要殺價。

examples.en: I haggled him down to half the original price.
examples.zh: 我把他的價錢殺到原價一半。

slang.usage: 形容很不願意花錢的人。

risk.note: 當面叫別人 cheapskate 很不客氣；自嘲沒問題。

examples.en: Don't be such a cheapskate. Leave a tip!
I'm a total cheapskate when it comes to clothes.
examples.zh: 買衣服這件事我超小氣。

slang.usage: splash out on something = 花大錢買某樣東西，通常是犒賞自己。

risk.note: 英式說法，美國人聽得懂，但自己常說 splurge（第 65 單元）。

examples.en: We splashed out on a fancy dinner for our anniversary.
examples.zh: 週年紀念我們揮霍了一頓高級晚餐。

examples.en: I don't usually splash out, but these boots were worth it.
examples.zh: 我通常不亂花錢，但這雙靴子值得。

slang.usage: 通常用否定：It won't break the bank. = 不會太貴。

examples.en: You can eat really well in Taipei without breaking the bank.
examples.zh: 在台北不用花大錢也能吃得很好。

examples.en: A weekend in Kenting won't break the bank.
examples.zh: 去墾丁過個週末不會花很多錢。

review.question: By the time I came back, someone ___ the last one.
review.explanation: 複習第 32 單元：過去完成式。

review.question: I bought gifts for my ___ kids.
review.explanation: 複習第 16 單元：一個表親用 cousin's，多個表親用 cousins'。
